plugins.name: firefox-mcp
plugins.description: Control Firefox for browsing, web testing, and debugging. Fill forms, capture network and console activity, take screenshots, run scripts, and profile performance. Supports Android devices.

plugins.name: firefox-mcp-troubleshoot
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix Firefox MCP setup issues. Use this if the firefox-mcp plugin is not working.

plugins.name: firefox-devtools-mcp
plugins.description: Renamed to firefox-mcp. This old entry only keeps the Firefox MCP server running for existing installs, with its old tool names. Install firefox-mcp to get the skills, agents and commands, then uninstall this one.
